title: Staff Engineer, Systems Design/Architecture Engineering
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead the architecture, development, and integration of SystemC/TLM-2.0 virtual platforms for complex multi-core SoCs, including processors, interconnects, memory subsystems, peripherals, accelerators, and custom IPs.Own individual IP modeling and lifecycle maintenance, ensuring alignment with evolving specifications.
* Define and own the virtual platform modeling strategy, methodology, coding standards, and reusable model libraries across programs.
* Serve as technical lead for multiple IP models and full-system platforms, managing them from specification through release and lifecycle maintenance.
* Drive shift-left enablement by delivering virtual platforms early for firmware, driver, OS, and application bring-up ahead of RTL and silicon availability.
* Architect models of complex system behavior, including memory-mapped transactions, interrupts, DMA, cache coherency, power management, security, and bus protocols
* Define model validation and RTL correlation strategies, including co-simulation and hybrid emulation flows, regression infrastructure, and quality metrics.
* Integrate virtual platforms with third-party and open-source ecosystems such as QEMU, Synopsys Virtualizer, Cadence, Siemens, and Arm Fast Models, as well as debuggers and CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with architecture, hardware, software, verification, and product teams to set VP requirements, milestones, and deliverables aligned with program schedules.
* Lead post-silicon validation and debug support by reproducing field and silicon issues on virtual platforms, performing root-cause analysis, and feeding results back into models and specifications.
* Mentor and technically guide P1–P3 engineers through design and code reviews and technical growth.
* Represent the modeling team in cross-site technical forums, customer engagements, and industry standards discussions

**Position Requirements:**

* Minimum B.E./B.Tech or MS/M.Tech/Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, or Computer Science.
* B.E./B.Tech with 8–12 years, MS/M.Tech with 6–10 years, or Ph.D. with 4+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Expert-level knowledge of SystemC, TLM-2.0, C, and modern C++ (C++14/17), including model performance optimization.
* Proven track record of architecting and delivering full-system SoC virtual platforms used in production software development.
* Deep experience with ARM and/or RISC-V processor architectures, including ISS/CPU model integration, boot flows, and software bring-up (bare-metal, RTOS, Linux).
* Strong understanding of SoC architecture, memory hierarchies, coherency protocols, interconnects, and hardware/software co-design.
* Experience with commercial or open-source VP tools and frameworks (e.g., Synopsys Virtualizer, Arm Fast Models, QEMU, GreenSocs/QBox).
* Experience with RTL co-simulation, hybrid emulation, or model-to-RTL correlation methods.
* Proficient in Python and build systems (CMake) for automation, model generation, and validation.
* Hands-on experience with software development practices and tools such as Agile, DevOps, Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and code-quality tooling.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading cross-functional initiatives, and influencing architecture decisions.
* Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware/software boundaries.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including presenting technical strategy to stakeholders and management.
* Ability to work across a geographically dispersed team and deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.Strong debugging, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Self-motivated team player with the ability to collaborate with team members of varying skillsets
* Ability to work effectively as part of a geographically dispersed team

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*
Job Req Type: Experienced
  
  
Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time
  
  
Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

title: Python Developer_4+ years
description:
We are looking for a skilled
 **Python Developer with hands\-on experience in GenAI, FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph** 
 to develop scalable and production\-ready AI applications.
   

  

 The candidate will work on
 **LLM\-based applications, RAG solutions, conversational AI, and agentic workflows** 
 , along with enterprise API and system integrations. The role requires strong backend development skills and the ability to independently deliver high\-quality solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop scalable REST APIs using FastAPI.
* Develop GenAI and LLM\-powered applications using Python.
* Build LLM workflows and integrations using LangChain.
* Design and orchestrate AI agents and state\-driven workflows using LangGraph.
* Develop RAG\-based applications, including retrieval, embeddings, and prompt orchestration.
* Build conversational AI solutions such as chatbots and virtual assistants.
* Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and knowledge bases.
* Work with Azure cloud services, including Azure OpenAI, App Services, and Functions.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with backend, UI, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
* Follow best practices for coding, testing, version control, and production deployment.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience in Python development.
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI and REST API development.
* Strong experience with LangChain for LLM orchestration.
* Hands\-on experience with LangGraph for agent orchestration and state\-based workflows.
* Experience developing GenAI / LLM\-based applications.
* Experience with RAG and prompt engineering.
* Good understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
* Experience integrating APIs and backend services.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and Git.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Azure OpenAI and Azure cloud experience.
* Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Microsoft 365 Agents SDK.
* Conversational AI / chatbot development.
* Agentic AI workflows.
* Vector databases and embeddings.
* Docker/containerization.
* CI/CD and DevOps practices.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering** 
 , or a related field.

title: Senior SAP CX/C4C Consultant
description:
SAP C4C Lead Consultant
 
**Position:** 
 SAP C4C Lead Consultant
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ Years
 



**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 



**Department:** 
 SAP Consulting
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a highly experienced
 **SAP C4C Lead Consultant** 
 with 10\+ years of SAP CRM/CX experience to lead SAP C4C engagements, solution design, implementations, integrations, enhancements, and support projects.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong functional and solutioning expertise in SAP C4C, excellent client\-facing skills, and proven experience in leading consulting teams and delivering complex SAP CX solutions.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Lead end\-to\-end
 **SAP C4C / SAP Cloud for Customer** 
 implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects.
* Act as the
 **SAP C4C functional lead and subject matter expert** 
 for client engagements.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP C4C solutions.
* Lead requirement\-gathering workshops, business process discussions, solutioning sessions, and client presentations.
* Design and oversee configuration of SAP C4C across
 **Sales and Service** 
 processes.
* Provide expertise across
 **Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Activities, Sales Quotes, Tickets, Service Requests, Visits, and related CRM processes** 
 .
* Lead solution architecture and functional design for complex business requirements.

 **SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA, and third\-party applications** 
 .

 Required Skills \& Experience
 * **10\+ years of overall SAP CRM / SAP CX experience** 
 , with significant hands\-on experience in
 **SAP C4C** 
 .
* Strong experience in
 **SAP C4C implementation, configuration, enhancement, integration, and support** 
 .
* Strong understanding of CRM business processes, particularly
 **Sales and Service** 
 .
* Proven experience in leading SAP C4C projects and functional teams.
* Strong experience in requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.

 **SAP ECC/SAP S/4HANA and non\-SAP systems** 
 .

* Experience working with senior client stakeholders and leading business discussions.
* Ability to independently analyze complex requirements and provide appropriate solution options.
* Strong experience in preparing and reviewing functional specifications, solution design documents, test scenarios, and project documentation.

 .

 **SAP Sales Cloud and SAP Service Cloud** 
 .
* Experience with
 **SAP Cloud Integration / CPI** 
 .
* Knowledge of
 **SAP Cloud Application Studio / PDI** 
 .
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration.
